match.title: Your vacancy match
match.stale: The profile or vacancy has changed.
match.weightsNote: Required skills have a default weight of 2 and preferred skills 1. Lower proficiency contributes proportionally. Text-only evidence and semantic links contribute at most 50%.
match.practice: Practise the skill in a small project and update your proficiency in the profile.
match.covered: All listed requirements are covered. Check the responsibilities and employment conditions.
match.conditionsNote: The skill score is based on your profile; check employment conditions and experience expectations separately.
match.requirementsTitle: How your skills meet the requirements
match.noRequirements: There are not enough requirements to calculate a score. The vacancy needs skill requirements.
match.fullCoverage: Your competencies cover all listed skill requirements. Review responsibilities and experience expectations before applying.
match.gapsExplanation: Fully covered requirements: {{matched}} of {{total}}. Improve {{skills}} to increase your match.
career.addSkills: Add skills with your current proficiency levels.
career.addProject: Add a project and its technologies.
career.title: From skills to a career
career.description: Practical steps based on your competencies and vacancy requirements.
career.practice: Build a small project using {{skill}}, practise the technology and update your profile.
career.noGapsHint: Complete your profile and select a direction, or explore other roles.
career.idea: An idea for your next project
career.extend: Extend an existing project with {{skills}}. Describe the result and list the technologies in your portfolio.
career.addPortfolio: Add an academic or personal project to your portfolio and list its technologies.
career.formula: Each component is scored from 0 to 1 and multiplied by its normalised weight.
career.formulaDescription: Vacancies: the average of up to five best target-role matches. Projects: coverage of required skills in project technologies. Experience: up to 180 relevant days without double-counting overlaps. Certificates: up to two relevant credentials. Education: completeness of university, degree, programme and year.
career.sample: Vacancies in the sample: {{count}}. The score reflects the data available on the platform.
career.directionsNote: The average of up to three best matches for each role. This is a skill-based guide, not a hiring prediction.
career.gapAction: Build a project using {{skill}} and recalculate your match with selected vacancies.
dashboard.marketDescription: Average match across up to five best vacancies; restricted to your target role when selected.
dashboard.projectsDescription: The share of required skills listed in your project technologies.
dashboard.experienceDescription: Relevant experience: up to 180 days, without double-counting overlapping dates.
dashboard.certificatesDescription: Up to two certificates with skills relevant to the selected vacancies.
dashboard.educationDescription: Completeness of university, degree, programme and graduation year.
dashboard.assessmentDescription: The score combines the weighted components below. Contributions are in percentage points and total {{score}}%. This is a guide based on platform data, not a probability of being hired.
dashboard.sampleNote: Vacancies in the sample: {{count}}. Other profile fields help refine your direction and support skill evidence; a separate profile completeness percentage is not calculated.
dashboard.missingSection: This section is not complete yet. Add details to refine your career overview.
dashboard.direction: Your direction is {{role}}. Here is what to focus on.
dashboard.description: Skills, suitable vacancies and practical steps towards your first job.
dashboard.readinessDescription: Skills, projects, experience, certificates and education.
dashboard.matchNote: These vacancies share skills with your profile; a match does not guarantee employment.
dashboard.gapsDescription: Skills needing higher proficiency or stronger evidence for selected vacancies.
dashboard.needRequirements: Vacancies with skill requirements are needed for analysis.
dashboard.bestMatches: The best available matches for your competencies.
dashboard.noMatchesHint: No vacancies in the current selection have a positive match score. Explore the catalogue or refine your profile direction.
dashboard.startSkillsHint: Add your technology proficiency levels to see matching vacancies here.
dashboard.demoNote: The percentage reflects coverage of skill requirements. Vacancies marked “Demo” are for testing and are not active offers.
dashboard.proficiencyNote: Competencies in your profile: {{count}}. The scale shows proficiency from 1 to 3, not vacancy match percentages.
dashboard.addSkillsHint: Add competencies and your current proficiency levels.
dashboard.gapsSample: Priorities for missing skills and proficiency levels across {{count}} sampled vacancies.
dashboard.learn: Learn or demonstrate this skill in a project.
dashboard.noGaps: No gaps identified in this sample
dashboard.noGapsNote: This applies to the current sample of requirements. You can explore other roles.
dashboard.insufficientHint: Select a direction and explore vacancies with skill requirements.
dashboard.completeHint: No priority gaps were found in this sample. Compare your profile with other vacancies.
